hero.subtitle: LOGISTICS
hero.title: Know what is in every storage before you run out
hero.body: Products and equipment by storage, every movement in and out, and a level that warns you when something runs low.

sections.title: Every storage on its own, with its value
sections.body: Keep products and equipment by type and by the place they are kept, with quantity, price and value.
sections.imageAlt: The inventory list: items by type and storage, with quantity, price and value

sections.title: Every item in and out, on record
sections.body: Each movement is logged, so the count you see is the count you have.

shot.what: A storage's movements, in and out

sections.title: A warning before the shelf is empty
sections.body: Set a level for each item. When stock falls under it, you see it in the platform.

shot.what: Two items under their low-stock level

items.q: Can each item have its own low-stock level?
items.a: Yes. You set the level item by item.

items.q: Can we keep stock in several places?
items.a: Yes. Every storage is kept on its own, with its own movements.

cta.title: See your storages in it
cta.body: In the demo we show you stock the way you keep it. We reply within one working day.

hero.subtitle: LOGISTIK
hero.title: Vid, hvad der er på hvert lager, før det slipper op
hero.body: Produkter og udstyr efter lager, hver bevægelse ind og ud, og et niveau, der advarer jer, når noget er ved at slippe op.

sections.title: Hvert lager for sig, med sin værdi
sections.body: Hold produkter og udstyr efter type og efter det sted, de opbevares, med antal, pris og værdi.
sections.imageAlt: Lagerlisten: varer efter type og lager, med antal, pris og værdi

sections.title: Hver vare ind og ud, registreret
sections.body: Hver bevægelse logges, så det antal, I ser, er det antal, I har.

shot.what: Et lagers bevægelser, ind og ud

sections.title: En advarsel, før hylden er tom
sections.body: Sæt et niveau for hver vare. Når beholdningen kommer under det, ser I det i platformen.

items.q: Kan hver vare have sit eget minimumsniveau?
items.a: Ja. I sætter niveauet vare for vare.

items.q: Kan vi have lager flere steder?
items.a: Ja. Hvert lager holdes for sig, med sine egne bevægelser.

cta.title: Se jeres lagre i platformen
cta.body: I demoen viser vi lageret, som I holder det. Vi svarer inden for 1 arbejdsdag.
